text:
Nothing documented happened to Paul McCartney on November 9, 1966. The "car crash" and "died that month" options in the team note both describe the "Paul is dead" hoax, which Wikipedia lists as a false rumour, not a real event. I haven't re-checked the sources in this turn, and I'd treat the minor pre-1966 scooter accident as separate from this date.

CONFIDENCE: 85
